question: What is vendor-managed inventory?
html:
Vendor-managed inventory (VMI) means we manage the lab supplies kept at a customer's site. We watch usage, decide when to refill and restock shelves, so the lab doesn't have to place routine orders itself.

How it works

  • Stock on site. Agreed consumables are kept at the customer's lab, pathology department or hospital.
  • We track usage. Our team monitors what gets used, through counts or scans.
  • We refill. Replenishment follows agreed levels, not ad-hoc purchase orders.
  • The customer sets the rules. Items, minimums and billing terms are agreed up front.

Where it fits

VMI is one of several services in our plan to move from distributor to lab supply-chain company (Thomas Scientific growth plan):

ServiceRole in the growth plan
Target-account sellingNamed coverage of Pursue and Nurture sites
Punchout orderingDigital ordering from customers' procurement systems
VMIKeeps accounts with us over time
Private labelImproves margin through mix

The plan states plainly that "VMI makes accounts sticky." It groups VMI with private label and AI pricing as ways margin "has to come from mix" (Thomas Scientific growth plan).

What we can't yet say

The context does not show:

  • how many accounts use VMI today;
  • what VMI does to revenue per account or to margin;
  • what it costs us to run on site.

Three things would answer those questions: account-level order and retention data, a comparison of service costs for VMI and non-VMI accounts, and gross margin by account. Any figure before then would be a guess.

Why it matters to the business: the growth plan puts cash and refinancing first, ahead of a first-lien maturity on Dec 14, 2027, and est. leverage is 7-10x (Thomas Scientific public filings). Sticky, higher-margin accounts are part of the growth story that earns the refinancing.

Next actions

  • Pull a baseline of current VMI accounts, with order frequency, retention and gross margin compared with similar non-VMI accounts.
  • Estimate the cost of running VMI at one site, including labour, inventory carried and systems. Label it est. until it is measured.
  • Screen the 713 Pursue sites for VMI fit, starting with high-volume consumable users (Thomas Scientific growth plan).
  • Keep any VMI pilot cash-light, so it does not compete with liquidity while the refinancing is open.
